summary: Corrected OPS-0004 for the owner's actual workflow, a browser at claude.ai/code (HD-0020), locally only. (1) Researched Claude Code on the web from six official documentation pages plus observation in this cloud session (evidence tags in BROWSER_REVIEW.md): a separate browser session shares no documented filesystem, so the reviewer rebuilds the review packet itself from GitHub-held inputs (the pushed baseline branch, the pushed OPS-0003 branch, GitHub's CI data), compares the manifest hash with a pinned value and regenerates the CI evidence from GitHub's API for six-section comparison; read-only isolation is instructed and not enforced in a browser (the CLI's --restricted refuses to create cloud sessions; the GitHub proxy does not limit which branch is pushed), so every browser review is advisory; the one unavoidable human action is a one-time push of exactly the OPS-0004 branch (OQ-0037). (2) Rewrote the runbook (browser first, terminal optional) with the exact launch message and rehearsed its real command blocks end to end; reviewer prompt 2.2.0-draft. (3) Recorded HD-0018 (claude/** features, claude-dev staging, main production), HD-0019 (Instagram and video production separate from the repository) and HD-0020, REQ-OPS-011 to 013, ADR-0014, CLAUDE.md sections 3, 13 and 14, policy 0.6.0 (PROHIB-017, required files, requirements and headings). (4) Investigated creative/ and the eight unpublished Reel commits read-only and wrote INSTAGRAM_SEPARATION_PLAN.md: 140 tracked files are already published on claude-dev, 196 locally, main has none, 5.4 GB of renders exist only on this container's disk; plan only, nothing under creative/ or any Reel commit was touched. No code, schema, gate or test changed; 465 of 465 tests pass. Nothing was pushed, merged or deployed, and no reviewer was run.

unresolved_issues.description: The browser procedure has not been run in a real browser session. Branch fetching from a new session, access to api.github.com, the permission prompts in Accept edits mode, the reviewer finding its own session identifier, and which branch a new session starts on are unverified; the documentation does not say whether the browser lets the owner choose a branch.

Read-only isolation of a browser reviewer is instructed, not technically enforced: file edits run without asking in every mode, Auto runs most commands without asking, --restricted refuses to create cloud sessions, and the GitHub proxy does not limit which branch a push can update. Every browser review is advisory.
The first reviewer test needs a one-time push of exactly claude/ops-0004-review-foundation, which only the owner can authorize (OQ-0037). Until then no browser session can reach the baseline commit.

5.4 GB of Instagram renders, exports, frames and audio exist only on this container's disk and are in no Git history; the eight unpublished Reel commits are only here and in the scratchpad copies. The container is ephemeral. The owner must choose a home for them (OQ-0038).

REQ-OPS-012 is violated today: 140 Instagram and marketing video files are tracked on the published claude-dev and on the two published OPS branches (30 commits). They stay in published history even after removal unless history is rewritten, which is not recommended (OQ-0039). main has none.
The Instagram rule is enforced by instruction only (CLAUDE.md section 13, PROHIB-017) until a technical guard lands with the removal.

The baseline is written by the developer session; the owner's review of OPS-0004 and the owner's check of the commit id on GitHub are the trust anchor. OPS-0003's trusted-base check remains advisory (OQ-0035) and the repository still lacks enforced separation between the owner's identity and the identity Claude acts under (OQ-0036).
